_comment: Firmware family resolution. A source override that is silently ignored builds the wrong tree and reports the result as the right one - the failure is a board flashed with firmware from a repo the user thought they had stopped using.

mutations.name: a configured source tree is honoured, not ignored
~ expands against the Paths home, not the process environment
mutations.find:
if text.startswith("~/") or text.startswith("~\\"):
        return os.path.join(home, text[2:])
mutations.replace:
if text.startswith("~/") or text.startswith("~\\"):
        return os.path.expanduser(text)

mutations.name: a fork's own artifact name is used, not the family name
the built artifact is looked for in the family's own tree
overriding one key on katapult does not silently turn off its bootloader status
an undeclared family is refused, never invented
mutations.find:
if family is None:
        raise ConfigCorruptError(missing_section_message(fw), path=paths.main_config, value=fw)

mutations.name: a declared family with no source: builds from ~/<name>
